autoFocus.description: Whether to automatically move focus into the action bar when it opens.

closeOnEscape.description: Whether to close the action bar when the Escape key is pressed.

closeOnInteractOutside.description: Whether to close the action bar when the user interacts outside of it.

defaultOpen.description: The initial open state of the action bar when it is uncontrolled.

lazyMount.description: Whether to defer mounting the action bar content until it is opened.

onExitComplete.description: Callback invoked when the action bar's exit animation completes.

onOpenChange.description: Callback invoked when the action bar opens or closes.

open.description: The controlled open state of the action bar.

unmountOnExit.description: Whether to unmount the action bar content when it is closed.

asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

unstyled.description: Whether to remove the component's style.
